book.title: Factfulness
book.author: Hans Rosling, Ola Rosling and Anna Rosling Rönnlund

predict.question: Your survey covers two towns: 80 people at an expected yes rate of 20% and 20 people at 80%. What combined expected rate do you get?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases and inspect what changes.
bookIdea: Group labels and dramatic extremes can obscure how populations are distributed.
modelBoundary: Actual sizes give {A}%; equal weighting gives {B}%. Group rates stay fixed; their denominators change the aggregate.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? This weighted average is exact for the stipulated rates. These groups are not income data or evidence for historical progress.
